limitations: Exact PyPI metadata and wheel digests do not establish artifact bytes, signatures, imported module identity, Basic/Pro desktop identity, entitlement, runtime behavior, modifier validity, or scientific acceptance.
Slice projections are validated against the provider source partition.

The exact v3.15.5 documentation tree and exact PyPI release metadata/artifact digests are inventoried; documentation bodies, generated references, distribution artifacts, imported bytes, desktop applications, entitlement, and user artifacts remain external.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

entries.description: Wheel files, installers, component notices, signatures, SBOMs, and imported module bytes are not downloaded or stored.
PyPI package metadata does not establish Basic desktop or Pro desktop entitlement, activation, or feature availability.
Release metadata and artifact hashes do not establish installation, import, runtime dependencies, platform compatibility, API behavior, or numerical correctness.
The exact JSON response hash and derived release fields are retained, but the raw PyPI JSON body is not.
